documentation: AWS CloudShell provides a browser-based, pre-authenticated shell environment in the AWS Management Console. This is an unofficial API model reverse-engineered from the AWS Console. AWS can change or break it at any time without notice.

DescribeEnvironments.name: DescribeEnvironments
DescribeEnvironments.documentation: Lists all CloudShell environments for the current IAM principal.

CreateEnvironment.name: CreateEnvironment
CreateEnvironment.documentation: Creates a new CloudShell environment. Call with no arguments for a public environment, or pass EnvironmentName and VpcConfig for a VPC environment. VPC environments require additional IAM permissions such as ec2:CreateNetworkInterface and ec2:CreateTags. There is a maximum of 2 VPC environments per IAM principal.

StartEnvironment.name: StartEnvironment
StartEnvironment.documentation: Starts a suspended CloudShell environment. The environment must be in SUSPENDED state.

StopEnvironment.name: StopEnvironment
StopEnvironment.documentation: Stops a running CloudShell environment. The environment transitions to SUSPENDED state.

GetEnvironmentStatus.name: GetEnvironmentStatus
GetEnvironmentStatus.documentation: Gets the current status of a CloudShell environment. Possible statuses include CREATING, RUNNING, and SUSPENDED.

CreateSession.name: CreateSession
CreateSession.documentation: Creates an interactive SSM WebSocket session to a running CloudShell environment. Use the returned StreamUrl, SessionId, and TokenValue with session-manager-plugin to get an interactive shell.

SendHeartBeat.name: SendHeartBeat
SendHeartBeat.documentation: Sends a heartbeat to keep a CloudShell environment alive. Environments go to sleep after a period of inactivity.

DeleteSession.name: DeleteSession
DeleteSession.documentation: Deletes an active session from a CloudShell environment.

DeleteEnvironment.name: DeleteEnvironment
DeleteEnvironment.documentation: Deletes a CloudShell environment. The environment must be in RUNNING or SUSPENDED state.

GetFileUploadUrls.name: GetFileUploadUrls
GetFileUploadUrls.documentation: Gets S3 presigned URLs and form fields to upload a file into the environment's home directory. Use the returned URL and fields in a multipart POST request.

GetFileDownloadUrls.name: GetFileDownloadUrls
GetFileDownloadUrls.documentation: Gets S3 presigned URLs to download a file from the environment.

PutCredentials.name: PutCredentials
PutCredentials.documentation: Forwards console credentials to the environment. This is used internally by the AWS Console and requires a console session token. It is not usable programmatically and will return a TokenDecryptionException. To inject credentials into a shell session, export them as environment variables instead.

EnvironmentName.documentation: Display name for the environment. Required when creating a VPC environment.

VpcConfig.documentation: VPC configuration for the environment. When provided, creates a VPC-attached environment instead of a public one.

VpcId.documentation: The ID of the VPC to attach the environment to.

SubnetIds.documentation: A list of subnet IDs within the VPC for the environment.

SecurityGroupIds.documentation: A list of security group IDs to associate with the environment. Maximum of 5 security groups.

VpcConfig.documentation: VPC configuration for a CloudShell environment. Requires additional IAM permissions including ec2:CreateNetworkInterface and ec2:CreateTags.

EnvironmentId.documentation: The unique identifier of the CloudShell environment.
The unique identifier of the CloudShell environment.
The unique identifier of the CloudShell environment.

SessionId.documentation: The unique identifier of the session to delete.

EnvironmentId.documentation: The unique identifier of the target CloudShell environment.

SessionType.documentation: The type of session to create. Use TMUX.

TabId.documentation: A unique tab identifier. Must be a valid UUID v4.

QCliDisabled.documentation: Whether to disable Amazon Q CLI integration in the session.

Environments.documentation: A list of CloudShell environments owned by the current IAM principal.

EnvironmentId.documentation: The unique identifier of the CloudShell environment.
The unique identifier of the CloudShell environment.

StatusReason.documentation: A human-readable reason for the current status, or null if not applicable.

SessionId.documentation: The unique identifier of the created session.

TokenValue.documentation: The token value used to authenticate the SSM session.

StreamUrl.documentation: The WebSocket URL for the SSM session. Use with session-manager-plugin to connect.

CreateSessionOutput.documentation: Output for the CreateSession operation. Contains the information needed to connect via session-manager-plugin.

FileUploadPresignedUrl.documentation: The S3 presigned URL to use as the POST target for file uploads.

FileUploadPresignedFields.documentation: A map of form fields to include in the multipart POST request when uploading a file.

FileDownloadPresignedUrl.documentation: The S3 presigned URL to download a file from the environment.

FileDownloadPresignedKey.documentation: The S3 key for the file download.

FileDownloadPresignedKeyHash.documentation: The hash of the S3 key for the file download.

FileTransferOutput.documentation: Output containing S3 presigned URLs and fields for file upload and download operations.
